paymentIds.description: Array of unique identifiers tying a conversion to Paytron payments.

forwardId.description: UUID identifying the forward for a conversion, if applicable

fixedSide.description: The side of the transaction that is fixed (buy or sell)

conversionDate.description: The day the conversion will start trying to execute (yyyy-mm-dd)

latestSettlementDate.description: The latest date that the conversion can be executed (yyyy-mm-dd)

delinquentDate.description: The business day the conversion will be considered delinquent (yyyy-mm-dd)

cardId.description: Card identifier when funded by credit card

sellCurrency.description: 3‑letter currency code of the sell currency

buyCurrency.description: 3‑letter currency code of the buy currency

createdBy.description: UUID of the creating user or client

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime of last update

updatedBy.description: UUID of the last updating user

amount.description: The amount of currency to convert
